# SalonGo

> SalonGo is salon management software for nail, hair, lash and beauty salons in Europe, built for Vietnamese-run salons (app in Vietnamese, Czech, Slovak, English, German and French). It runs in the browser, as a desktop app for Windows and macOS, and in the phone browser. Every plan has every feature; plans differ only by staff per location and number of locations.

Website: https://www.salongo.eu (languages: /vi, /cs, /de, /en). App: https://app.salongo.eu. Support in Vietnamese and Czech: salongosupport@gmail.com, +420 728 568 807.

## Features
- Online booking page for each salon (client picks service, staff and a free time; the salon confirms in the app).
- Appointment calendar per staff member and as a list; email reminders to clients 24 h and 1 h before.
- Checkout (POS): cash, card, bank transfer, tips recorded on the invoice; invoices exported to PDF.
- Clients: profiles, visit history, VIP rules, membership/points program, birthdays.
- Email marketing: 10 occasion templates (sale, new service, Christmas, New Year, Valentine's, Women's Day, Easter, Mother's Day, summer, Black Friday), sent only to clients who agreed, with one-click unsubscribe; birthday reminders for the owner.
- Reports: overview, revenue by staff/service/payment method, invoices.
- Payroll: each staff member is paid a percentage of their own revenue (optionally per service) or a fixed monthly salary; tips go to the staff member the client tipped or are split equally, as the owner chooses.
- Staff accounts on the phone: staff see only their own schedule (view only).
- Multiple locations in one owner account, with an "All salons" overview; each location has its own plan.

## Pricing (CZK per month, from the app)
- Basic 199: up to 3 staff per location, 1 location.
- Pro 499: up to 8 staff per location, up to 3 locations.
- Premium 799: unlimited staff and locations.
- Paying yearly saves 10%. New salons get a 150-day free trial, no card needed. Plans are renewed in the app (Plan screen).
